title: Team
description: Dentists and hygienists, what they do, where and when they work

help.title: About team
help.overview: Each team member has a public profile, the treatments they do, the locations they work at, and weekly working hours per location.

sections.title: On this page
items: Link a staff login to let that person see only their own appointments and day.
Working hours changes apply to new bookings at once; existing appointments stay where they are.
Someone with upcoming appointments can't be deactivated until those are moved or cancelled.
